title: Queen's House | Thirdway
description: Thirdway partners with owners, occupiers, and professional teams to create world-class spaces.

main.className: container mb-10 flex flex-col text-center text-pretty xl:mb-16

main: From Local Landmark to Destination Workplace

main.className: relative m-2 aspect-377/361 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:m-4 lg:aspect-1408/792

main: Delivered for MR Q, this ambitious retrofit offers a top-tier co-working environment and commercial amenity across three beautifully designed floors in St Albans.

Queens House called for the restoration and retrofit of a former straw hat manufacturing warehouse in the heart of St Albans. The ambition was to deliver best-in-class commercial space that could balance the performance demands of a contemporary workplace with a textured and characterful aesthetic. The client’s needs were multifaceted: a ground-floor coworking hub for local workers and sole traders, a subdivided first floor for multiple tenants, and a top floor headquarters for MrQ, complete with a private terrace. Supporting these was a suite of high-quality lower-ground amenities – showers, vanities, and secure cycle storage – to promote sustainable commuting and enhance wellbeing.

Queen’s House is extraordinary not by scale alone but by its ambition: it transforms a locally listed warehouse into a destination workplace for the city of St Albans. One that embodies its client’s brand, celebrates its context, and creates a benchmark for adaptive reuse in the region.

main.className: aspect-[16/9] relative mx-2 overflow-hidden rounded-xs lg:mx-4 lg:aspect-[1408/792]

main: The retrofit has transformed Queens House into a considered series of interconnected spaces, responding to a diverse range of users and ways of working. Purpose-built podcast rooms, call booths, meeting spaces and flexible tenancies introduce variety and adaptability, while shared kitchens, breakout areas and a landscaped courtyard create moments for interaction and connection. More intimate retreat spaces offer quieter places to pause, focus and work.

The design extends beyond the workplace itself, with lower-ground end-of-journey facilities supporting active travel and a socially focused ground floor creating a new hub for the building. At the top of the building, the headquarters opens onto a sunlit terrace, offering views across the city and a natural connection to the outdoors.
